title: Lanao del Sur farmers get climate-resilient rice farming training

blocks.text: MARAWI CITY — Around 200 rice farmers from Maguing and Poona Bayabao in Lanao del Sur received fertilizer assistance after participating in a training program on improving rice production and adapting to climate change, particularly the effects of El Niño. The Provincial Government of Lanao del Sur, through its Office of the Provincial Agriculturist (OPAg), conducted the training on the PalayCheck System as part of its flagship agriculture and livelihood program. In a post on its official Facebook page, the provincial government said the participants received either urea or complete fertilizer to support their rice production.
